# agyn_mcp_server (Resource)

Manages an Agyn MCP server.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "agyn_mcp_server" "example" {
  title       = "My MCP Server"
  description = "An example MCP server managed by Terraform."
  namespace   = "example"
  command     = "mcp start --stdio"
  workdir     = "/srv/mcp"

  restart {
    max_attempts = 5
    backoff_ms   = 1000
  }

  env {
    name  = "LOG_LEVEL"
    value = "info"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `command` (String) Command to run for the MCP server.
- `config` (String, Deprecated) Deprecated JSON-encoded MCP server configuration. Use structured attributes instead. Cannot be used together with the structured configuration attributes. Use one approach or the other.
- `description` (String) Human-readable description of the MCP server.
- `env` (Attributes List) Environment variables for the MCP server process. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--env))
- `heartbeat_interval_ms` (Number) Heartbeat interval in milliseconds.
- `namespace` (String) Namespace for the MCP server.
- `request_timeout_ms` (Number) Request timeout in milliseconds.
- `restart` (Attributes) Restart policy configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--restart))
- `stale_timeout_ms` (Number) Stale timeout in milliseconds.
- `startup_timeout_ms` (Number) Startup timeout in milliseconds.
- `title` (String) Human-readable title of the MCP server.
- `workdir` (String) Working directory for the MCP server process.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID identifier of the MCP server.

<a id="nestedatt--env"></a>
### Nested Schema for `env`

Exactly one of `value` or `value_ref` must be specified.

Required:

- `name` (String) Environment variable name.

Optional:

- `value` (String) Literal environment variable value.
- `value_ref` (Attributes) Reference to a vault or variable-backed value. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--env--value_ref))

<a id="nestedatt--env--value_ref"></a>
### Nested Schema for `env.value_ref`

Required:

- `key` (String) Key within the referenced secret.
- `kind` (String) Reference kind (vault or variable).
- `mount` (String) Mount name for the referenced secret store.
- `path` (String) Secret path within the referenced store.



<a id="nestedatt--restart"></a>
### Nested Schema for `restart`

Optional:

- `backoff_ms` (Number) Backoff duration in milliseconds between restarts.
- `max_attempts` (Number) Maximum restart attempts.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by UUID
terraform import agyn_mcp_server.example 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```
